title: fanoutqa: How old is each of the main cast members of the TV series Girls? (ae1c3cec94b75e55)

chat_history.content: How old is each of the main cast members of the TV series Girls?

content.content:
Need ages of main cast members of TV series Girls. Main cast: Lena Dunham, Allison Williams, Jemima Kirke, Zosia Mamet. Also maybe Paul Rudd? He was a recurring. Probably main cast: Lena Dunham (born 1986), Allison Williams (born 1989), Jemima Kirke (born 1981), Zosia Mamet (born 1987). Ages as of now? Current date 2025-11-01. So compute ages: 2025 - birth year, adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet. Let's find exact dates.

Lena Dunham: born June 13, 1986. As of Nov 1, 2025, she turned 39 on June 13, 2025. So age 39.

Allison Williams: born August 31, 1989. She turned 36 on Aug 31, 2025. So 36.

Jemima Kirke: born May 31, 1981. She turned 44 on May 31, 2025. So 44.

Zosia Mamet: born January 14, 1987. She turned 38 on Jan 14, 2025. So 38.

Also maybe Paul Rudd was two seasons. Paul Rudd born May 6, 1969. He turned 56 in 2025. Not main cast though.

Also maybe Selena Gomez cameo? No.

Thus answer: 39, 36, 44, 38.

We should provide ages. Maybe include birthdays.

Let's answer accordingly.
